title: Finite stage-image expressions have forward-stage representatives
statement: Let J be small filtered, F : J → Cat, P_j arbitrary precoverages, and V a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are set colimits. Let Q be any precoverage on V.pt. Assume only continuity of the stage transition functors and V_j. Fix i, G on P_i, and alpha_t as in def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image, satisfying the unit equations of the original representative theorem. For U in F_i and x in H(V_i U), assume x belongs to the explicitly constructed additive subgroup generated by restrictions of stage images. Then there exist t in Under i and a section y of the stage inverse image at F(t.hom)(U) with HEq(alpha_t(y), x). No finiteness, cover lifting, cover stability or preservation of covering pullbacks is assumed. This is a refinement result for finite additive expressions, without a statement that all sections belong to the subgroup.

source.place: Tag 0A35, independence of presentations and restriction construction; Categories Tag 04AX, filtered object and arrow representatives

proof.text: For a generator H(r)(alpha_t(T)(y)), represent r by joint surjectivity of the arrow-colimit legs. Move this arrow representative and t.right to a common stage. The source and target images equal V_i(U) and V_t(T). Apply the same-stage object-colimit eventual-equality criterion twice, successively, to align its source with the forward image of U and its target with the forward image of T. Compose the represented arrow with eqToHom at both endpoints. Functoriality and cocone naturality show that its arrow image is precisely r. Set the forward presentation to t.hom composed with the resulting refinement. Transpose the adjunction unit to construct the stage transition; uniqueness of adjuncts and h-alpha identify its composite with the later alpha with the original alpha. Naturality at the lifted arrow, followed by the cocone endpoint transport, gives the desired forward-stage representative. Reuse the existing private sheaf_triangle_comp theorem from ColimitSiteAbelianSectionDiagram through a proof-only import all; do not restate sheaf_unit_unique or sheaf_triangle_comp.

Use AddSubgroup.closure_induction on membership in the explicitly generated subgroup. The generator case is the lifted-arrow construction. Zero is the zero section at Under.mk(identity i); negation uses the negative representative. For addition use filteredness of Under i to choose a common successor of the two forward presentations. The unit-transposed stage transitions take the two representatives there, and their compatibility with alpha makes their sum a representative of the sum. Transported alpha maps k have k_t = transition followed by k_later, proved using Arrow equality and naturality. Finally remove the endpoint transport by heterogeneous equality of eqToHom application. This is implemented completely in Lean, with no sorry.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_stage_image_refinement
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (x : ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
        (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hx : x ∈ ColimitSiteStageImage.subgroup F P V Q i G α
      (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))) :
    ∃ (t : Under i)
      (y : ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))),
      HEq ((α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) y) x
